name: Mary Dirksen

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Dirksen lists her occupation as ODOT senior policy analyst, with 24 years at ODOT.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: ODOT Senior Policy Analyst; Mom Occupational Background: 24 years serving Oregonians at ODOT.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 41

bio.statement: Dirksen lists dual bachelor's degrees in human resources management and general management from Portland State University.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: Dual bachelor’s degrees in Human Resources Management and General Management, Portland State University.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 41

bio.statement: Dirksen lists advisory committees on trafficking intervention, Tualatin budget and U.S. Department of Transportation, a Coffee Creek Correctional Facility volunteer role and USDA Forest Service.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: Oregon Trafficking Intervention Advisory Committee; U.S. Department of Transportation Advisory Committee on Human Trafficking; City of Tualatin Budget Advisory Committee; 15-year Coffee Creek Correctional Facility volunteer; USDA Forest Service.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 41

positions.statement: Dirksen says she will prioritize public safety by putting victims first, supporting law enforcement and holding repeat offenders accountable.
positions.excerpt: Public safety: putting victims first, supporting law enforcement, and holding repeat offenders accountable.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 41

positions.statement: Dirksen says she will prioritize fiscal responsibility, including reining in spending, transparency and tax relief for working families.
positions.excerpt: Fiscal responsibility: reining in wasteful spending, demanding transparency, and delivering meaningful tax relief so working families can keep more of what they earn.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 41

positions.statement: Dirksen says she will prioritize education, including strong academics, curriculum transparency and parental involvement.
positions.excerpt: Education: focusing on strong academics, curriculum transparency, parental involvement, and real opportunity for every student.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 41

positions.statement: Dirksen says she will prioritize economic growth so small businesses thrive and cost of living no longer pushes families out.
positions.excerpt: Economic growth: making Oregon a place where small businesses thrive so the cost of living no longer pushes families out.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 41
